info.title: API.SH: Booking.com
info.description: The Booking.com API from API.SH: public Booking.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Airports and cities matching a name or code, as Booking.com flights suggests them: type (airport or city), IATA code, name, city, region, country, the airport's distance to the city centre, an image, and `flights_place`, the value /booking/v1/flights takes for from and to.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-airports

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A city, airport name or code.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the names (default en), e.g. de, fr, es.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tours, tickets and activities in a destination: id, name, description, URL, city, rating, review count, price, duration, free cancellation, image and labels. Find the destination with `q` or pass its `ufi`. Page 1 also returns `available_filters` (sort options and type, label, price, rating, language, time-of-day and area filters with counts) and `total`. Pass `next_page` as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-attractions

get.description:
Rental cars for a pick-up place and dates: car model, class and categories, price and drive-away price, pay-now or pay-later, free cancellation, seats, doors, suitcases, transmission, air conditioning, mileage, fuel policy, deposit, image, supplier with logo and rating breakdown, pick-up and drop-off desk, and every fee. `aggregates` holds the category, supplier and filter counts. Pages over the result set with `offset`/`limit`; pass `next_offset` (null at the end).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 6 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-cars

get.description:
One-way or round-trip flight offers: total price with base fare, taxes and fees, and per segment the airports, times, duration, stops and each leg's flight number, carrier, operating carrier and cabin, plus cabin and checked luggage allowances and the branded fare. `aggregation` holds the filter counts and minimum prices by stops, airline, times and duration. 15 offers per page; pass `next_offset` as `offset` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-flights

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin airport code (JFK), city code (LON.CITY) or place name.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Destination airport code, city code or place name.

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a round trip.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offer offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Booking.com hotel: description, address, coordinates, rating, facilities, rooms, photos, policies, Q&A and featured reviews. With checkin/checkout, the page for those dates is read: `room_cards` lists its rooms (size, occupancy, beds, availability blocks; prices when Booking includes them in the page) and `room_offers` the classic availability table when the page has one. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-hotel

parameters.name: checkin
parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). With checkout, the response includes `room_offers` (rooms, prices, conditions) for those dates.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Booking.com hotel review scores and filters
get.description:
Review category scores (staff, facilities, cleanliness, comfort, value for money, location, free WiFi) with the city's average range, the review score distribution and every review filter with counts: sort options, traveler types, languages, time of year, scores, topics and room types (values usable with hotel-reviews).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-hotel-review-scores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every review of a Booking.com hotel, 25 per page, from Booking's own review list: score, title, liked/disliked text, language, date, guest (name, country, traveler type), stay (room, dates, nights), the hotel's reply and photos. Sort and filter like the site; `available_filters` lists each filter's values with counts. Pages after the first are one small request. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-hotel-reviews

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: most_relevant (default), newest, oldest, highest, lowest.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Reviews to skip; pass `next_offset` back. 25 per page.

parameters.name: customer_type
parameters.description: families, couples, groups, solo, business (or a value from `available_filters.customer_type`).

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Review languages, comma-separated (e.g. en,fr); values in `available_filters.languages`.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: true: also read the hotel page on page 1 (featured reviews, Q&A, subscores). Otherwise the summary comes from cache.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every room type of a hotel for the given stay with its bookable rates: price for the stay and per night, total with taxes and fees, excluded and included charges (VAT, city tax), discounts, cancellation type (free cancellation or non-refundable), meal plan, max guests and the rate id. `available` is false (and `rooms` empty) when the hotel is sold out for those dates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-hotel-rooms

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotels and other properties for a destination (or around a point): name, address, review score and count, stars, price, image and link, and for every property also location, distance to the centre (`distance` as the site words it and `distance_to_centre_km`; for a point search, from that point), `badges` (the labels the result card shows: deal and price badges, Genius, Preferred Partner, sustainability, new property, free cancellation, no prepayment, meal plan, rooms left, top location, ad), free cancellation, meal plan, price per night, price before discount, taxes and fees not included (`taxes_and_fees`), deal labels, rooms left at this price, free cancellation deadline, Genius rate flag, sustainability certifications and the matching unit (names, type, bedrooms, bathrooms, beds, area). Sort with `sort` and filter by stars, review score, nightly price, property type, amenities, meals, bed type, neighborhood, brand, free cancellation and distance, or pass any filter ids in `nflt`. `filters` lists the filter groups with each option's id (usable in `nflt`) and its number of results.

Pagination: result offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booking-search

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude: hotels around a point instead of q (with longitude), nearest first.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius around the point in km (up to 100).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Destination or hotel name (optional when latitude/longitude are given).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Result offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity (default), homes_first, price (lowest first), price_desc, review_score_and_price, stars (high to low), stars_asc, stars_and_price, distance (from the center) or top_reviewed.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Property type ids, comma-separated (e.g. 204 hotels, 201 apartments, 203 hostels; see the `ht_id` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: facilities
parameters.description: Property amenity ids, comma-separated (the `hotelfacility` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: room_facilities
parameters.description: Room amenity ids, comma-separated (the `roomfacility` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: meal_plan
parameters.description: Meal plan ids, comma-separated (e.g. 1 breakfast included; the `mealplan` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: bed_type
parameters.description: Bed preference ids, comma-separated (the `tdb` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Hotel brand ids, comma-separated (the `chaincode` group in `filters`).

parameters.name: distance_km
parameters.description: Only properties within this distance of the center, in km (e.g. 1, 3 or 5; the `distance` group in `filters` lists the offered values).

parameters.name: nflt
parameters.description: Any filter option ids from `filters`, joined with `;`, e.g. `class=4;fc=2;popular_activities=404`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
